description: Aquarius Writer's main window. Deliberately narrow: the vault is reached through this app's own commands (which need no permission and do their own path checks), so the only plugin permissions granted are the folder picker and the four window-chrome actions our own title bar performs. The AquariusOS updater added in v0.2.0 needs nothing new here either — its four commands are our own, and the `updater://state` event it emits is covered by the listener permission inside `core:default`.
